HediffDef.label: hearing the Stormfather
HediffDef.description: This pawn hears a vast, ancient voice calling to them from the storms. The Stormfather — a manifestation of Honor's power — seeks a bond with one who leads and unites.

HediffDef.label: hearing the Nightwatcher
HediffDef.description: This pawn senses a presence from the Horneater Peaks — the Nightwatcher, daughter of Cultivation, who grants boons and curses. She seeks a bond with one who saves and heals.

HediffDef.label: hearing the Sibling
HediffDef.description: This pawn feels the pulse of something vast and protective beneath the colony. The Sibling — the spren of the tower, of knowledge and shelter — reaches out to one who builds and discovers.
